a: Up to $500,000/yr for up to 5 years
dt: No deadline: letters of inquiry (up to 2 pages, with the lead PI's CV) are accepted on a rolling basis; full proposals are by invitation
e: Sloan's Matter-to-Life program funds research on the physical principles that distinguish living systems from non-living matter (building life, principles of life, signs of life such as atmospheric signatures); biomedical and disease-related research is not supported. This award supports a collaboration of two or more PIs, for experiment, theory or both.
unv: sloan.org blocked automated access (HTTP 403) on Oct 21, 2026. The award sizes and LOI format come from search results of Sloan's Matter-to-Life page and its LOI guidelines (last updated Mar 18, 2022), which give no LOI deadline; the rolling LOI status comes from Yale's InfoReady listing, not from Sloan's own page.

yale.t: Not a limited submission. Yale applicants should contact Zandra Ruiz (zandra.ruiz@yale.edu), Corporate and Foundation Relations, before applying.
